title: Persist applicant CV uploads and reject foreign CV paths
description: REQ-APPLY-CV-001: Repair the candidate application form so selected PDF/DOCX files are uploaded through the existing authenticated private CV endpoint and the returned storage_path is submitted instead of the browser filename. The application API must accept cv_url only when the storage_path belongs to a cv_documents row owned by the authenticated candidate; preserve optional CV behavior, existing candidate-role, Turnstile, expiry, and duplicate checks. Update all four locale CV size labels to match the existing 10 MB upload limit. OpenCode is the sole implementation writer; Chief validates; Cline performs read-only review.
acceptanceCriteria: Selected CV uploads to /api/aday/cv before application POST; submitted cvDosyaYolu equals server-returned storage_path, never File.name; failed upload creates no application; API rejects unregistered or other-candidate storage paths and accepts registered paths owned by the current candidate; no-CV submission remains optional; only PDF/DOCX up to 10 MB are described in tr/en/ru/he; type-check/lint pass; no new dependency; no commit by OpenCode.
